scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
issuing_authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India (Administered by LIC)
target_group: Small and marginal farmers (SMFs) aged 18 to 40 years possessing cultivable land up to 2 hectares

eligibility_rules.description: Age between 18 and 40 years at the time of entry
Occupation is farmer with cultivable landholding
No family member is an active income tax payer
Not covered under other social security schemes like NPS, ESIC or EPFO

benefits.amount: Rs 3,000 per month upon reaching 60 years of age
benefits.duration: Lifelong monthly pension (50% family pension to spouse upon demise)
benefits.instalments: Direct Benefit Transfer to bank account through Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)

required_documents: Savings Bank Account Passbook (IFSC & Account number)
application_steps: Visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or visit maandhan.in
Provide Aadhaar and bank details for initial auto-debit contribution (Rs 55 to Rs 200/month depending on entry age, with matching 50% central govt contribution)
Biometric authentication and verification of land record
Instant issuance of Kisan Pension Card with unique Pension Account Number
source_document: PM-KMY Operational Guidelines, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
